what: Onto Innovation makes inspection and measurement systems for chip manufacturing, particularly for advanced packaging, where several chips are assembled into one module, and the software that analyses the results.
customers: Semiconductor manufacturers, packaging houses and foundries.
money: inspection and metrology for packaging and specialty chips
metrology for leading-edge logic and memory
moat: Inspection systems qualified into a packaging line, in a niche that was small until AI accelerators made advanced packaging the bottleneck of the entire industry.
risks: Revenue fell from $1.0B to $816M in the 2023 downturn, so the cycle still bites
Revenue is concentrated in a handful of large customers
opportunities: $640M of cash against $17.5M of debt and $248M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 68% upside, with 12 covering the stock
Advanced packaging is where every AI accelerator is assembled, and inspection demand grows with it
watch: Advanced packaging revenue and bookings from AI-related customers.
